title: The inbox shows an open question's notes under it
intention: The operator inbox prints every note an open question carries under that question, oldest first, each with who wrote it and when.
why: db99e97f7b4f (built 2026-10-11) gives an open question a 'notes' list (cairn/tools/question/question.py note()) and renders it in cairn question show, but left cairn/tools/operator_inbox alone under RULE 1, so the QUESTIONS FOR OPERATOR section prints only id, ticket, question and born_of. Akien reads questions in the inbox; a note taken there to help him answer is invisible where he answers.
traces_to: Akien's review bandwidth (memory akiens-review-bandwidth-is-the-binding-constraint): what helps him answer must be where he answers.
